# eScholarship@McGill

> McGill University's institutional repository providing open-access discovery and preservation of scholarly works, theses, dissertations, and research publications.

eScholarship@McGill is McGill Libraries' digital repository platform built on the Scholaris infrastructure, serving as the central hub for McGill's scholarly output and academic archive. The repository enables researchers, students, and the public to discover, access, and preserve McGill's intellectual contributions through faceted search and advanced discovery tools.

## Key Topics

- institutional repository
- open access
- scholarly works
- theses and dissertations
- research publications
- digital scholarship

- repository migration

## Discovery & Search

- [Advanced Search](https://escholarship.mcgill.ca/advanced): Advanced search interface for eScholarship@McGill repository with faceted discovery options to refine and explore scholarly works
- [Catalog Index](https://escholarship.mcgill.ca/catalog): Searchable catalog of McGill scholarly works and digital scholarship collections with browse and discovery capabilities

## Repository Home

- [eScholarship@McGill Home](https://escholarship.mcgill.ca): McGill University's institutional repository for scholarly works and open-access research, providing access to theses, dissertations, and research publications

## Optional

- [Terms of Use](https://escholarship.mcgill.ca/terms): Terms of use, copyright, and licensing information for eScholarship@McGill content and services
